label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param (derived from request parameter names via getParameterNames()) which is attacker-controllable through crafted HTTP requests; user input reaches response.getWriter().format() without HTML sanitization. Alert 2 (java/tainted-format-string): alert-TP — same resolved sink value (param) is used as the format string argument in format(), creating a format string vulnerability. Both alerts share the same vulnerable path where attacker-controlled data reaches the sink.

evidence.note: User input flows from getParameterNames() through param variable
Switch statement assigns param to bar based on switchTarget
Sink: bar passed to response.getWriter().format() for both XSS and format string vulnerabilities
